text.tspan: Security groups: a stateful firewall around each instance (allow rules only)
Security group sg-web (attached to the instance)
• stateful: reply traffic is allowed back
• rules reference IP/CIDR or another SG
Timeout (hangs) → security group / NACL / route problem
"Connection refused" → SG let you in; the app
is down or not listening on that port
Good practice: keep a separate SG just for SSH access. A SG lives outside the instance: if traffic is blocked,
the instance never sees it. In a VPC a SG works at the instance (ENI) level; a NACL works at the subnet level and is stateless.
